services.name: Summer Fishing Camp
services.desc: Your kid(s) will experience fun and education this summer fishing locally on a private boat each day. Captain Jeff will teach your child the fundamentals of fishing or give new pointers to those already with some experience. Fishing is never the same every day because of the tide, wind and weather conditions. Typical fishing will consist of fishing for bluegills, bass, striped bass, and even sturgeon if conditions allow. Each camper will learn basic techniques and learn how to adapt to different changes. Throughout the week, the campers will be taught the following: Please pack a lunch and water for your kid(s). Cooler will be provided to store camper's lunch. Extra water will be provided.
